hypothesis: The fixed workload exhibits a nearly constant baseline, two initial elevated states, and additional excess cost at lengths 5 and 12. These entry-state indicators test that empirical pattern; they are workload-specific proxies rather than established causes.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt_token_ids) if prompt_token_ids is not None else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_length
pcvs.rationale: Models the cost of copying the prompt list.

pcvs.expression: int(prompt_token_ids is not None and len(prompt_token_ids) == 1)
pcvs.name: single_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the first observed state, which has substantially higher constructor cost.

pcvs.expression: int(prompt_token_ids is not None and len(prompt_token_ids) == 2)
pcvs.name: two_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the second observed state, which also has elevated cost.

pcvs.expression: int(prompt_token_ids is not None and len(prompt_token_ids) % 7 == 5)
pcvs.name: periodic_elevated_state
pcvs.rationale: Tests the shared excess cost observed at prompt lengths 5 and 12.
